2610.03872.title: Training Numerical Intelligence via Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery
2610.03872.paper_summary: AI agents are becoming increasingly capable of generating scientific code, but generating code is not the same as improving the algorithms behind it. For numerical solvers, execution feedback can expose poor performance, but rarely reveals its underlying cause and how to address it. We introduce Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery (ADSD), a framework that links numerical diagnosis to reusable solver self-improvement. ADSD follows a diagnosis-first paradigm that first explains why a solver performs poorly, then uses this diagnosis to guide the discovery of appropriate numerical methods. The resulting knowledge is packaged into reusable solver skills, turning solver improvement from trial-and-error editing into a structured process of diagnosis, discovery, and implementation. Across four challenging numerical domains--power flow equation, AC optimal power flow control, stiff ordinary differential equations, and heterogeneous diffusion PDEs--ADSD consistently improves solver accuracy, robustness, and efficiency. On GOC-500 power flow, for example, ADSD reduces mean solver error by nearly $71\times$, with improvements further transferring to unseen grid topologies and operating regimes.
2610.03872.paper_summary_zh: AI代理變得越來越能夠生成科學代碼，但生成代碼並不等同於改善其背後的算法。對於數值求解器來說，執行反饋可以揭示性能不佳，但很少揭示其根本原因以及如何解決它。我們介紹自動診斷與技能發現（ADSD），這是一個將數值診斷與可重用求解器自我改善聯繫起來的框架。ADSD遵循診斷優先的模式，首先解釋為什麼求解器表現不佳，然後利用這一診斷來指導適當數值方法的發現。所產生的知識被打包成可重用的求解器技能，將求解器的改進從試錯編輯轉變為診斷、發現和實施的結構化過程。在四個具有挑戰性的數值領域——功率流方程、交流最佳功率流控制、剛性常微分方程和異質擴散偏微分方程中——ADSD始終提高了求解器的準確性、穩健性和效率。例如，在GOC-500功率流上，ADSD將平均求解器誤差減少了近$71\times$，並且改進進一步轉移到未見的網格拓撲和操作模式。
2610.03872.author: Peter Chen et.al.
